observation: Target INT 6Ch handler calls its update routine and returns with RETF 2; this path does not save the interrupt return address in a separate field. The DOS 6 reference handler in bios/msinit.asm pops the return address into int6c_ret_addr and jumps via that field.
change: Keep the legacy int6c_ret_addr field only when DOS7_CONFIG is undefined; a diagnostic stub satisfies the unchanged reference msinit object.
limitations: This establishes the observed handler path, not the absence of every possible other use of such a field. The linked diagnostic uses legacy objects and stubs; it is not a complete DOS 7 build.
